- **Real kernel:** `TestD085_LiveReadNetlab` (`-tags netlab`, `make -f mk/node.mk node-test-live-netlab` → `tests/netlab/agent/run-live.sh`, foreground `fvpn-w2-agent-core-live-*` container, real `SystemPlane`): `clsact` + ingress `matchall`/`mirred` redirect after successful serving → the next step reports non-serving with `TC_FOREIGN_FILTER` to the TLS fake control; after the harness removes its filter a clean Apply restores serving. Measured cost: mean live read 17.5 ms (p95 19.1 ms), **52.6 ms added per normal serving step** (3 reads, 30 steps); fake plane 1.24 µs. The baseline does not neutralize a foreign ingress redirect — D-090 (netlab follow-up 13 primitive, agent-core follow-up 22 consumer at `rejectServing(ctx, model, evidence, err)`) remains needed.
